title: Market Morning with Mango Moko
summary: An original Likkle Legends story about Mango Moko helping a neighbor carry fruit at the Saturday market.

pages.text: Saturday sun woke Mango Moko. The market bell would ring soon.
pages.illustration: A cheerful boy in a straw hat opening a bright window onto a Caribbean street

pages.text: He packed a basket of mangoes. The fruit smelled sweet and sunny.
pages.illustration: A basket of ripe mangoes on a wooden table with a yellow cloth

pages.text: On the road he met Miss Coral. Her bag of limes was too heavy.
pages.illustration: A kind neighbor with a heavy bag of limes and the boy offering to help

pages.text: Mango Moko said, We can carry it together. One handle each.
pages.illustration: Two people sharing a basket down a colorful street

pages.text: At the market, steelpan notes floated over the stalls.
pages.illustration: A sunny market with fruit stalls and a small steelpan in the background

pages.text: They set the limes in a neat row. Miss Coral smiled.
pages.illustration: Limes lined up on a market table, both characters smiling

pages.text: A little girl wanted one mango. She had a shiny coin.
pages.illustration: A small girl holding a coin toward a mango, the boy kneeling to her height

pages.text: Mango Moko gave her the ripest one. Thank you, she said.
pages.illustration: The boy handing a mango to the girl, market colors all around

pages.text: Miss Coral shared a lime drink. It was cool and tart.
pages.illustration: Two cups of lime drink under a market umbrella

pages.text: The End. Helping makes a market morning brighter.
pages.illustration: The boy waving goodbye with an empty basket and a big smile
